notes.title: Major update: HD version!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/bae324c782d3074cabfb242bac6a5d2fb0521e1c.jpg
Work on the game is moving towards release, and we continue to improve the demo version of the game. Meet the HD update, which fixes numerous shortcomings of the early version!

 +20% to FPS. Due to the integration of a wrapper for modern versions of DirectX, the game now functions much faster!
 New HDR lighting. The lighting system received a major update, due to which the "pitch black syndrome" was defeated on a number of configurations.
 Numerous bug fixes. Fixed a number of issues with collisions, freezes and level drops.
 Interface improvements. The game is now clearer and easier to control than before.
 Auto-detect of settings. New players will now be offered a settings configuration tailored to your computer.


Please try the new version!

notes.title: EAX Patch - a fantastic update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/1e8e87f2836a08c998c585e526318a758433ac18.jpg
We've worked a lot, and made a giant patch to our demo. 
New things are:

 A support for a groundbreaking EAX sound technology - a golden classics of surrounding sound from 2000-s. The DSOAL library helped us a lot. Our engine doesn't have a full EAX support, and your system could have some problems with it - so this feature is still experimental. Enable it with great care in Option menu!
 Menu system overhaul - now everything's a bit better: new Options (like mouse inversion), auto-skip system for intro, better visuals. Also, new players would see a new menu for Quality/Performance and EAX settings.
 Fixes for annoying fall-through-level problem. Now it won't break your gameplay anymore.
 Fixes for Infernus gun. Now it won't slow down your PC so much.
 Daemonic Shotgun and Infernus were rebalanced.
 Roboskulls and Slayers were tuned down a bit.
 Fixes for gamma and logging system, other small bugfixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/f5472bdad215eb35ba267395dc4db3fce4757c4a.png
Go and play!

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/9da14e57f3fbd561e4e4f1916f0af654975fd15a.jpg
We've fixed some annoying problems in our demo

 Gamma level setting haven't worked as intended.
 Monsters were able to hurt player during his reading of tutorial screens.


Also we've added a new functional for logging in v.2.0.0.3. 
If you have problems, please enable "Produce logs" in options. This will activate a special "yellow" loading screen. When game ends, it would consequently open two files of logs in a Notepad (second one could be missing). Please copy that texts and send to us. It would help us a lot!

notes.title: Slipgate Demo 2.0 - a JUMBO-sized update!
notes.notes:
Proud to present... Slipgate Demo 2.0!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/c7ca9a88d10e92d59b8c6c1010771f1ebe3127df.jpg

We spent a lot of time, went through changes and difficulties to make our game 120% cooler! I won't be lying if I say that we've reworked the entire thing to make it more fun, bloodier, and meaner!
This demo contains NEW content, so if you've played an old one - come and play again, it's worth your time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/8c69ea4e1da56532364c9c72262920b0329891dc.png
What could you get with Demo 2.0?
[olist]
New gameplay mechanics and levels.
Much improved speed and stability.
Intro and outro videos (not a final one, though)
Updated monsters and fresh weapons.
More gore and gibs!
[/olist]
Come and get it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/783725cf7bb2db4c5f383b683220bf316e084399.png
P.S. If you're experiencing slowdowns, turn render mode in Options menu to Performance!

For feedback and chat with friends - Discord server of the game.
